name: shoutout
description: Desktop notification system with Electron client, WebSocket server and Discord bot

scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run audit:prod
scripts.check:syntax: node --check server/src/index.js && node --check client/main.js && node --check bot/src/index.js
scripts.audit:prod: npm --workspace server audit --omit=dev && npm --workspace client audit --omit=dev && npm --workspace bot audit --omit=dev
